verdict.rationale: github-docs-6 ("Update vulnerable dependencies with supported fixes for breaking changes") and github-docs-14 (security campaigns/Copilot Autofix to reduce vulnerabilities) point to GitHub's Dependabot-style automated dependency update capability, which is a well-known GitHub feature, but the evidence pack only contains thin marketing bullets rather than detailed first-party docs describing the automatic PR workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated Dependabot documentation describing PR creation triggers/config, and independent/hands-on corroboration that PRs are actually opened automatically.
